![The Genos Inbox with a What to do today report listing where to start](/lp/guide/en/inbox.webp)

Schedule **What to do today** in **Settings → Genos**. It arrives in your Inbox at the time you pick.

By default it is built from your tasks and to-dos, with no AI and no credits.

Core and above.
